title: Transparent AI-driven personalized risk prediction system for acute kidney injury after total hip arthroplasty.
summary: CatBoost after feature selection and SMOTEENN; KDIGO AKI outcome, 97/4,601 events, internal AUC .95 and external AUC .65 in n=240. Methods/Results: CatBoost after feature selection and SMOTEENN; KDIGO AKI outcome, 97/4,601 events, internal AUC .95 and external AUC .65 in n=240. Testing: Independent hospital test is valuable but the AUC decline to .65 shows limited transportability; treat as a preliminary risk-prediction model, not clinically ready.. The primary article reports an AKI risk model in 4,601 THA patients and independent hospital validation; this is an eligible clinical prediction result when bounded by the weak external performance. Source affiliation was not stated in the reviewed case checks and was unavailable in the local bibliographic cache.
